verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Grafana ingests data from many sources (Prometheus, CloudWatch, Loki, Tempo) and mentions Grafana Alloy as an agent for sending logs, plus community confirms broad usage across cloud and hardware monitoring, but there is no explicit documentation of a curated integrations library covering hosts/containers/Kubernetes/cloud-specific vendor agents beyond the single Alloy mention. missing for 10: dedicated docs on Grafana Cloud Integrations catalog, Kubernetes-specific agent/exporter guidance, and cloud-provider-specific integration setup instructions.
